result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred insurance position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, conditional cyber coverage at USD 5M for processing Corio or Customer data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. However, the one-year post-termination requirement is not required by the playbook and unnecessarily applies to all coverages. Drafting also needs correction because it duplicates Section 14.10, appears after the agreement’s execution language, and refers ambiguously to renumbering a 'subsequent Section.' The existing bankruptcy and integration provisions are otherwise preserved.
